# Overview 

Welcome to `charwash()`!\above

`charwash()` reviews the content of character columns within your dataframe and returns information about the non-standard ascii characters within (if any).



# Support

Support is provided via [pharmaverse Slack](https://pharmaverse.slack.com/).
